title: Change the licence class or details on a native animal keeper licence
summary: You can change your name, contact details, or add a licence class on your native animal keeper licence online.
intro:
You can change your name or contact details or add a licence class on your native animal keeper licence online.

If you want to change your contact details only, you can do this over the phone.
what_you_need: To change your details, you will need to have the information found at https://www2.environment.nsw.gov.au/licences-and-permits/wildlife-licences/native-animals-as-pets/apply-for-a-native-animal-keeper-licence#licence-fees-and-duration

how_to_steps.text: Follow the prompts to submit your changes.

faqs.q: How can I change my contact details only?
faqs.a: If you only want to change your contact details, you can do this over the phone.
